other_conditions: Must own agricultural land between 0.25 acres (0.1 ha) and 10 acres (4 ha).
Must be registered on the DBT portal of the Agriculture Department.
Ryot farmers can claim benefits based on land documents; non‑ryot farmers based on contract form.
Beneficiaries will be selected on a first‑come‑first‑served basis.
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy up to ₹80,000 per hectare for marigold cultivation (maximum 4 hectares).
